request:
Which modules of the click library package (files under src/click/) start with a module docstring (a leading # comment block is not a docstring)? Give the repository-relative file path.

explanation: Selects files under src/click/ whose description is a real module docstring (description_source = 'module_docstring'), excluding files whose description came from a leading comment block or heading_purpose. Returns the repository-relative path.
